sentences.text: Son las cinco de la mañana.
sentences.english: It is five in the morning.

sentences.text: Es temprano y hay poca luz.
sentences.english: It is early and there is little light.

sentences.text: Doña Marta se levanta primero.
sentences.english: Doña Marta gets up first.

sentences.text: Ella siempre se levanta temprano y se baña.
sentences.english: She always gets up early and bathes.

sentences.text: Prepara el café y calienta el pan.
sentences.english: She makes the coffee and warms the bread.

sentences.text: A las seis, va al cuarto de Nico.
sentences.english: At six, she goes to Nico's room.

sentences.text: —Nico, despertate.
sentences.english: "Nico, wake up.

sentences.text: ¡Son las seis!
sentences.english: It's six o'clock!"

sentences.text: Nico abre un ojo.
sentences.english: Nico opens one eye.

sentences.text: No quiere levantarse.
sentences.english: He does not want to get up.

sentences.text: —Un momento más, abuela.
sentences.english: "One more moment, grandma."

sentences.text: —Nico, vestite y vení a la mesa.
sentences.english: "Nico, get dressed and come to the table."

sentences.text: —Nada de momentos.
sentences.english: "No moments.

sentences.text: Hoy hay clase, y los alumnos no llegan tarde.
sentences.english: Today there is class, and students do not arrive late."

sentences.text: Nico por fin se despierta.
sentences.english: Nico finally wakes up.

sentences.text: Piensa en la luna y en las estrellas de anoche.
sentences.english: He thinks about the moon and the stars of last night.

sentences.text: Anoche se acostó tarde.
sentences.english: Last night he went to bed late.

sentences.text: Escuchó la lluvia mucho tiempo.
sentences.english: He listened to the rain for a long time.

sentences.text: En la casa hay una ducha pequeña, con una pared azul.
sentences.english: In the house there is a small shower, with a blue wall.

sentences.text: La ducha está cerca del patio.
sentences.english: The shower is near the patio.

sentences.text: Nico se baña con agua fría.
sentences.english: Nico bathes with cold water.

sentences.text: ¡Qué fría!
sentences.english: How cold!

sentences.text: Usa un jabón blanco.
sentences.english: He uses a white soap.

sentences.text: El jabón se cae al piso, y Nico busca el jabón.
sentences.english: The soap falls to the floor, and Nico looks for the soap.

sentences.text: Después toma la toalla azul.
sentences.english: Then he takes the blue towel.

sentences.text: La toalla está en el piso.
sentences.english: The towel is on the floor.

sentences.text: —Nico, la toalla va en el patio, no en el piso —dice doña Marta.
sentences.english: "Nico, the towel goes in the patio, not on the floor," says doña Marta.

sentences.text: Nico se mira en el espejo y se cepilla el pelo.
sentences.english: Nico looks at himself in the mirror and brushes his hair.

sentences.text: El espejo está en la pared.
sentences.english: The mirror is on the wall.

sentences.text: Tiene la cara limpia y el pelo negro.
sentences.english: He has a clean face and black hair.

sentences.text: Ahora tiene que vestirse.
sentences.english: Now he has to get dressed.

sentences.text: Hoy va a usar su pantalón azul y su camisa blanca.
sentences.english: Today he is going to wear his blue pants and his white shirt.

sentences.text: Se pone los zapatos que Sam le regaló.
sentences.english: He puts on the shoes that Sam gave him.

sentences.text: Los zapatos son nuevos.
sentences.english: The shoes are new.

sentences.text: Quiere mostrar los zapatos a todos sus amigos.
sentences.english: He wants to show the shoes to all his friends.

sentences.text: La camiseta del perro está en una caja, en su cuarto.
sentences.english: The T-shirt with the dog is in a box, in his room.

sentences.text: Hoy no la usa.
sentences.english: Today he is not wearing it.

sentences.text: Se mira la cara de nuevo en el espejo.
sentences.english: He looks at his face in the mirror again.

sentences.text: —Estoy bien —piensa.
sentences.english: "I look good," he thinks.

sentences.text: Nico se sienta a la mesa.
sentences.english: Nico sits at the table.

sentences.text: Doña Marta se sienta también.
sentences.english: Doña Marta sits down too.

sentences.text: Hay frijoles, huevo, tortilla y café.
sentences.english: There are beans, egg, tortilla and coffee.

sentences.text: Nico quiere probar el café de su abuela.
sentences.english: Nico wants to try his grandmother's coffee.

sentences.text: —Tenés diez años, Nico —dice ella—.
sentences.english: "You are ten years old, Nico," she says.

sentences.text: Tomá agua.
sentences.english: "Have some water."

sentences.text: —¿Cómo dormiste? —pregunta doña Marta.
sentences.english: "How did you sleep?" asks doña Marta.

sentences.text: —Me acosté tarde, abuela.
sentences.english: "I went to bed late, grandma.

sentences.text: Estaba pensando en la oscuridad.
sentences.english: I was thinking about the darkness."

sentences.text: —La luna y las estrellas no se van —dice ella—.
sentences.english: "The moon and the stars do not go away," she says.

sentences.text: Esta noche las ves de nuevo.
sentences.english: "Tonight you will see them again."

sentences.text: Kevin, un vecino, va al colegio.
sentences.english: Kevin, a neighbor, goes to high school.

sentences.text: Hoy busca a Nico en la calle.
sentences.english: Today he looks for Nico in the street.

sentences.text: —¿Vamos?
sentences.english: "Shall we go?

sentences.text: Yo paso por tu escuela —dice Kevin.
sentences.english: I pass by your school," says Kevin.

sentences.text: Los dos caminan.
sentences.english: The two walk.

sentences.text: Kevin habla de su colegio.
sentences.english: Kevin talks about his high school.

sentences.text: Tiene mucha tarea hoy, y tiene la cara triste.
sentences.english: He has a lot of homework today, and he looks sad.

sentences.text: —Yo hice mi tarea anoche —dice Nico—.
sentences.english: "I did my homework last night," says Nico.

sentences.text: Nunca llego sin ella.
sentences.english: "I never arrive without it."

sentences.text: La tía de Kevin vende pan en la calle.
sentences.english: Kevin's aunt sells bread in the street.

sentences.text: Ella les da dos panes.
sentences.english: She gives them two loaves.

sentences.text: Luis llega a la escuela a las seis.
sentences.english: Luis gets to the school at six.

sentences.text: Él también llega temprano.
sentences.english: He also arrives early.

sentences.text: Los alumnos llegan y se sientan.
sentences.english: The students arrive and sit down.

sentences.text: La clase empieza a las siete.
sentences.english: Class starts at seven.

sentences.text: La lección de hoy es sobre el país.
sentences.english: Today's lesson is about the country.

sentences.text: Luis explica la lección: habla del gobierno y de la comunidad.
sentences.english: Luis explains the lesson: he talks about the government and the community.

sentences.text: —El gobierno construyó la escuela donde estamos —dice—.
sentences.english: "The government built the school where we are," he says.

sentences.text: Pero la comunidad ayudó.
sentences.english: "But the community helped."

sentences.text: —Un país cambia cuando la gente quiere mejorar.
sentences.english: "A country changes when people want to improve.

sentences.text: Y la tierra también cambia.
sentences.english: And the land changes too."

sentences.text: —Ahora la tarea.
sentences.english: "Now the homework.

sentences.text: Hablen con un viejo del pueblo.
sentences.english: Talk with an old person from the village.

sentences.text: Pregunten cómo era la vida antes.
sentences.english: Ask how life was before."

sentences.text: El techo de la escuela es rojo, y las paredes son blancas.
sentences.english: The roof of the school is red, and the walls are white.

sentences.text: Parece que va a llover.
sentences.english: It looks like it is going to rain.

sentences.text: Los alumnos escriben su nombre y la fecha.
sentences.english: The students write their name and the date.

sentences.text: Nico escribe la lección en su libro.
sentences.english: Nico writes the lesson in his book.

sentences.text: El alumno que llega primero gana un lugar cerca de Luis.
sentences.english: The student who arrives first wins a place near Luis.

sentences.text: Hoy hay un cambio: la clase termina al mediodía.
sentences.english: Today there is a change: class ends at noon.

sentences.text: Sam llega a la escuela al mediodía.
sentences.english: Sam arrives at the school at noon.

sentences.text: Él y Nico se sientan en el patio, cerca del jardín.
sentences.english: He and Nico sit in the patio, near the garden.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Nico, ¿a qué hora te levantás?
sentences.english: Nico, what time do you get up?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Me levanto a las seis.
sentences.english: I get up at six.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mi abuela me despierta, y ella se levanta a las cinco.
sentences.english: My grandmother wakes me up, and she gets up at five.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo, a las cinco, como tu abuela.
sentences.english: I, at five, like your grandmother.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Y Kevin?
sentences.english: And Kevin?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿A qué hora sale del colegio?
sentences.english: What time does he get out of high school?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: ¿Y te bañás con agua fría?
sentences.english: And do you bathe with cold water?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Sí, como vos.
sentences.english: Yes, like you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: En la casa todos nos bañamos con agua fría.
sentences.english: In the house we all bathe with cold water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Después me visto, me cepillo el pelo y me siento a la mesa.
sentences.english: Then I get dressed, I brush my hair and I sit down at the table.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo también me cepillo el pelo, ¡pero no tengo mucho!
sentences.english: I brush my hair too, but I do not have much!

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Y vos, te vestís antes o después del desayuno?
sentences.english: And you, do you get dressed before or after breakfast?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Antes.
sentences.english: Before.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Al mediodía siempre tengo hambre, pero la ducha de mi casa es pequeña.
sentences.english: At noon I am always hungry, but the shower in my house is small.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: ¿A qué hora se acuestan ustedes?
sentences.english: What time do you all go to bed?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo me acuesto a las diez.
sentences.english: I go to bed at ten.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mi abuela se acuesta a las ocho.
sentences.english: My grandmother goes to bed at eight.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Yo, a las nueve.
sentences.english: I, at nine.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Los domingos, doña Marta se pone su vestido azul para el culto.
sentences.english: On Sundays, doña Marta puts on her blue dress for the service.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Y yo me pongo los zapatos nuevos.
sentences.english: And I put on the new shoes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: ¡Gracias, Sam!
sentences.english: Thank you, Sam!

sentences.text: Los dos comen y miran el jardín.
sentences.english: The two eat and look at the garden.

sentences.text: Ahora hay flores, y antes había solo tierra.
sentences.english: Now there are flowers, and before there was only dirt.

sentences.text: Por la tarde, Nico vuelve a la casa.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, Nico comes back to the house.

sentences.text: Doña Marta lo espera en el patio con pan y café.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is waiting for him in the patio with bread and coffee.

sentences.text: La abuela quiere saber todo: qué hizo Luis, qué dijo Kevin y qué comió Nico.
sentences.english: His grandmother wants to know everything: what Luis did, what Kevin said and what Nico ate.

sentences.text: Nico le cuenta todo.
sentences.english: Nico tells her everything.

sentences.text: También le dice que Sam es muy simpático.
sentences.english: He also tells her that Sam is very friendly.

sentences.text: Por la noche, los dos cenan frijoles con queso y miran la luna.
sentences.english: At night, the two eat beans with cheese and look at the moon.

sentences.text: —Mañana llego más temprano a la mesa —dice Nico.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow I will get to the table earlier," says Nico.

sentences.text: —Vamos a ver, mi niño —dice doña Marta—.
sentences.english: "We will see, my boy," says doña Marta.

sentences.text: Ahora acostate, que mañana hay clase.
sentences.english: "Now go to bed, because tomorrow there is class."
